svg.title: Level sets of V and a trajectory
svg.desc: Each step of x_{k+1} = A x_k lands on a smaller ellipse of V(x) = x transpose P x. The first step leaves the dashed unit circle, so the Euclidean norm grew, yet V still fell.
svg.text: x₁ is outside the unit circle:
x₁ is inside V's level set:
the energy V still went down.
